desc.en: Capri by Kronos Homes, Estepona – new 2- and 3-bedroom apartments and penthouses, from €379,000 + VAT Capri by Kronos Homes is a new residential development in Estepona (La Resina), on the New Golden Mile of the Costa del Sol. It sits on the slopes of the River Guadalmansa, looking out to the Mediterranean and sheltered by the Sierra Bermeja mountains. Architecture by TAU 2000 (Óscar Puga). Phase 3 is now on sale: 2- and 3-bedroom apartments and penthouses from €379,000 + VAT (2 bedrooms, 103 m² built including common areas). Homes range from 101 to 152 m² built including common areas, with terraces from 15 to 146 m²; ground-floor homes have private gardens and penthouses have solariums. The most expensive home in the current price list is a 3-bedroom penthouse at €774,000 + VAT. Every home comes with a parking space, some also with a storage room. Completion according to the developer: phase 1 – Q4 2026, phase 2 – Q1 2027, phase 3 – Q3 2029. The building licence covers phases 1, 2 and 3. The open-plan living room and kitchen open onto the terrace. Kitchens are fully equipped with oven, microwave, induction hob, extractor hood, fridge and dishwasher. Ducted hot and cold air conditioning, domestic hot water from aerothermal energy, motorised blinds in the living room and master bedroom, built-in wardrobes, large-format wood-look flooring and a video door entry system. Communal areas: landscaped gardens, two outdoor swimming pools, a spa with a pool with a hydromassage zone, a cold-water plunge pool and a sauna, a fully equipped gym and a co-working space with a kitchenette. Automatic access gate and access control. The development will have a BREEAM rating. La Resina Golf & Country Club, Selwo Aventura, supermarkets and pharmacies are nearby. Puerto Banús is about 10 minutes away and Málaga airport less than 45 minutes (developer's data). Payment plan (developer's terms): reservation €6,600 including VAT; 25% + VAT on signing the private purchase contract, minus the reservation; 10% + VAT six months later; 65% + VAT on completion at the notary. We offer online video viewings and support you through the entire purchase — from reservation to the notary — in English or Russian. Prices are net and exclude VAT and other taxes (developer's price list of 26.10.2026); prices and availability may change. Contact us for current availability, floor plans and specifications.

Гостиная с кухней открывается на террасу. Кухни полностью оборудованы: духовка, микроволновка, индукционная варочная панель, вытяжка, холодильник и посудомоечная машина. Канальный кондиционер на тепло и холод, горячая вода от аэротермии, электрические жалюзи в гостиной и главной спальне, встроенные шкафы, крупноформатный пол под дерево и видеодомофон. Автоматические ворота и контроль доступа. Комплекс получит сертификат BREEAM. Рядом гольф-клуб La Resina Golf & Country Club, Selwo Aventura, супермаркеты и аптеки.
